name: Waste Recovery Technology Inc.
summary: Waste Recovery Technology Inc. engages in the recycled metal service, and waste liquid electrolysis recovery equipment in Taiwan. It offers a dimensionally stable anode product for copper plating; Recocell electrowinning system to treat various copper-containing wastewater; solvent extraction system for copper-containing wastewater; and PCB on-line electrowinning recycling system for acid and alkaline etching process. The company is also involved in wholesale, import, and export of wastewater treatment equipment and spare parts; provision of technical consultation; repair and maintenance services; and sales of metal products.
